message:
🎉 PichiPie TV v2.4.0 is here!

✨ What's New:
• 🍿 Spacious Movie Header & Details Polish — Elegant two-tier top bar (Sync, Search, Filter & Sort never overlap) + redesigned movie details page where Play, Resume & Trailer buttons are always beautifully visible and focused!
• 📌 Sticky Screen Headers — Screen heading and subtext stay permanently fixed and crisp at the top while card rows smoothly slide underneath with a cinematic fade shadow!
• 🎬 Movie Poster Fix — Direct CDN stream headers restore high-res posters for Servers 1, 4 & 5 (Latest Cinema, Bangla Dubbed, Bangla Cinema).
• ⚡ Smart Chunked Catalog — Instant 0ms catalog load (60-title initial + 40-batch auto-scroll) with a live progress counter badge.
• 🔲 Universal Focus Glow — Full 4-sided glowing border on hover/focus for every card on every screen with zero clipped corners.
• 🏆 Fitted Sports Match Cards — Full fixture artwork visibility without cropping team flags or tournament banners.
• 🛠️ Critical Buffer Fix — Stream Buffer profile (Fast 5s / Smart 15s / Resilient 30s) now correctly applies to ExoPlayer.
• 💤 Sleep Timer — Set 15, 30, 60, or 90 min auto-close countdown in Settings → Video & Audio.
• 🔙 Smarter Back Navigation — Clears active search/filter before exiting movie browser.
• 🧹 Player Stability — Full resource cleanup on exit, eliminating memory leaks.

Enjoy the most powerful PichiPie TV yet! 🍿
